تووكلت (form VI)
# تُوُوكِلْتُ (tuwūkiltu) /tu.wuː.kil.tu/: first-person singular past passive of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
# تُوُوكِلْتَ (tuwūkilta) /tu.wuː.kil.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
# تُوُوكِلْتِ (tuwūkilti) /tu.wuː.kil.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
# تُوُوكِلَتْ (tuwūkilat) /tu.wuː.ki.lat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
